Academic_Calendar_Public_Holidays: Public holidays and semester breaks are listed in the Academic Calendar; classes are generally suspended on gazetted public holidays.
Academic_Calendar_Registration_Period: Course registration periods are listed in the Academic Calendar, usually opening shortly before each semester begins.
Academic_Calendar_Semester_Dates: Semester start and end dates are published in the official Academic Calendar on the Intranet, updated each intake (e.g. Feb/June/Oct).
Bill_Installment_Eligibility: Installment plan eligibility is assessed by the Finance Office on a case-by-case basis; supporting documents such as proof of financial hardship may be required.
Bill_Installment_Late_Penalty: Missing an installment payment may incur a late fee and could affect your ability to register for the following semester; contact the Finance Office promptly if you anticipate a delay.
Bill_Installment_Plan_Application: To apply for a fee installment plan, submit a request form to the Finance Office along with supporting documents before the semester payment deadline.
Bill_Installment_Schedule: Installment schedules are arranged with the Finance Office and typically split fees into 2-3 payments across the semester.
Bus_Services_Operating_Days: Buses generally operate Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays, study leave period, and semester holidays. Check the current published schedule for exact operating days.
Bus_Services_Routes: TARUMT Penang provides 3 bus lines: Sungai Nibong, Jetty & Komtar, and Farlim, covering various stops around Penang island.
Bus_Services_Schedule: The TARUMT Penang bus schedule is updated each semester (and sometimes adjusted for unexpected changes); the current schedule is published on the Penang branch website under Campus Life > Bus Service.
Change_Of_Program_Cross_Faculty: Yes, switching to a course in a different faculty is available during the first two weeks of a new semester.
Change_Of_Program_Same_Faculty: To switch to a different course within the same faculty, email the programme leader with your supporting reason for the change.
Cocurriculum_Graduation_Impact: Cocurriculum is compulsory - failing to pass means the subject must be repeated, and students cannot graduate until they pass it.
Cocurriculum_Repeat_Policy: If a cocurriculum activity (e.g. Volleyball) was selected during Diploma studies, students cannot choose that same activity again when they progress to Degree level.
Cocurriculum_Requirement: Each course (e.g. Diploma in Computer Science) has one compulsory cocurriculum subject. Students must attend co-cu classes and pass the assessment to satisfy the subject; failing means repeating it, and students cannot graduate without passing.
Cocurriculum_Selection_Process: Students select their desired cocurriculum activity via the Intranet when registration opens for their new course.
Contact_Admissions: The Admissions Office can be reached via the contact details listed under 'Apply Now' on the TARUMT website, or in person during office hours.
Contact_General_Enquiry: For general enquiries, contact the TARUMT Penang main office via phone or email listed on the official TARUMT website.
Contact_Student_Affairs: The Student Affairs office handles student welfare matters; contact details are available on the TARUMT website or campus directory.
Course_Info_Degree_Programmes: TARUMT Penang offers bachelor degree programmes including Bachelor of Accounting and Finance (Hons), Bachelor of Business Administration (Hons), Bachelor in International Business Management (Hons), Bachelor in Finance and Investment (Hons), Bachelor in Applied Business Analytics (Hons), Bachelor in Data Science (Hons), Bachelor in Software Engineering (Hons), Bachelor in Information Technology (Hons), Bachelor in Public Relations (Hons), and Bachelor of Electronics Engineering Technology (Hons).
Course_Info_Diploma_Programmes: TARUMT Penang offers diploma programmes including Diploma in Accounting, Diploma in Banking and Finance, Diploma in Business Administration, Diploma in E-Marketing, Diploma in Finance and Investment, Diploma in International Business, Diploma in Human Resource Management, Diploma in Computer Science, Diploma in Information Technology, Diploma in Broadcast Communication, Diploma in Public Relations, Diploma in Building, Diploma in Quantity Surveying, and Diploma of Electronic Engineering.
Course_Info_Faculties_Overview: TARUMT Penang campus has 7 faculties: Accountancy, Finance and Business (FAFB); Applied Sciences (FOAS); Built Environment (FOBE); Communication and Creative Industries (FCCI); Computing and Information Technology (FOCS); Engineering and Technology (FOET); and Social Science and Humanities (FSSH).
Course_Info_Foundation_Programmes: TARUMT Penang offers Foundation programmes as a pathway into diploma and degree studies; check the current prospectus or Admissions Office for the specific foundation streams available this intake.
Course_Info_Prospectus: The latest TARUMT prospectus, listing all programmes and entry requirements, can be downloaded from the official TARUMT website or collected at the Admissions Office.
Course_Reg_Add_Drop: The add/drop period is usually around 2 days, though the exact timing varies by semester with no fixed date - check the current semester's announcement on the Intranet.
Course_Reg_Clash_Timetable: If your selected courses have a clashing timetable, the system will flag it during registration. You'll need to choose an alternate section/group or contact the Faculty for assistance.
Course_Reg_Deadline: The course registration deadline is announced in the academic calendar each semester; check the Intranet or Academic Calendar for the exact date.
Course_Reg_Online_Portal: Course registration is done via the TARUMT Intranet using your student ID and password. Technical issues should be directed to IT Support.
Course_Reg_Process: Course registration is done via the Intranet during the registration period announced each semester. Log in with your student credentials, select your courses, and confirm your timetable before the deadline.
Dress_Code: Students must wear collared shirts/t-shirts with sleeves and pants/jeans/skirts (no torn attire); shirts should be tucked in (except Hawaiian-style); shorts are not allowed; female students should avoid overly revealing clothing (mini skirts, low necklines, exposed midriff, spaghetti straps); proper footwear is required (no Japanese slippers); and the student ID card must be worn at all times. TARUMT campus is also a non-smoking/vaping zone. Full details: https://www.tarc.edu.my/dsa/a/student-dress-code/
Enrollment_International_Passport_Applic: International students may apply using their passport in place of a Malaysian NRIC; ensure a scanned copy is uploaded during the application.
Enrollment_New_Application: New students can apply to TARUMT Penang by submitting an online application through the TARUMT Admissions Portal, along with academic transcripts and identification documents.
Enrollment_Processing_Fee: A non-refundable processing fee applies when submitting your application, payable online via the admissions portal; check the current amount with the Admissions Office.
Enrollment_Required_Documents: Documents typically required to enroll include your SPM/STPM/UEC (or equivalent) results, identification card/passport, and passport-sized photos.
Enrollment_Requirements: Enrollment requirements vary by programme but generally include minimum SPM/STPM/Diploma results as stated in the prospectus for each course.
Facilities_Canteens_Food: Several canteens are located around TARUMT Penang campus, offering a variety of local food options, including halal-certified stalls, at student-friendly prices.
Facilities_Overview: TARUMT Penang campus offers facilities including a library, cafeteria, sports complex, computer labs, and student lounges across the campus.
Facilities_Printing_Services: Printing services are available at the library and computer labs on campus using your student card credit or coin-operated printers.
Facilities_Sports_Complex: The sports complex at TARUMT Penang includes courts for badminton, basketball, and futsal, available for student use during operating hours.
Facilities_Study_Spaces: Study spaces are available in the library and designated quiet zones around campus, open during library operating hours.
Faculty_Info_Academic_Advisor: Your academic advisor is assigned based on your programme and can be found on your student portal profile; they assist with course planning and registration.
Faculty_Info_Lecturer_Consultation: Consultation bookings with a lecturer can usually be arranged via email or during their posted consultation hours listed on the course outline.
Faculty_Info_Office_Hours: Faculty office opening hours are generally Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM, excluding public holidays.
Faculty_Info_Office_Location: All faculty offices at TARUMT Penang are located in Administration Block B (the right-side building of the Main Foyer).
Faculty_Info_Which_Faculty_For_Programme: Each programme is managed by a specific faculty - for example, business and accounting programmes fall under FAFB, computing programmes under FOCS, and communication programmes under FCCI. Check the prospectus or Admissions Office for the exact faculty of your intended programme.
Goodbyes: You're welcome! Feel free to reach out anytime if you have more questions. Have a great day!
Greetings: Hello! Welcome to TARUMT Penang's virtual assistant. How can I help you today?
Hostel_Off_Campus_Referral: TARUMT Penang branch does not have an on-campus hostel. New students can visit the Department of Student Affairs office during open days to get a list of agents/owners renting rooms near campus.
IT_Support_Email_Issues: For student email login issues, verify your credentials are correct or contact the IT Helpdesk to reset your email account access.
IT_Support_Helpdesk_Location: The IT Helpdesk is located at Administration Block A, 2nd floor (the left-side building leading off the Main Foyer).
IT_Support_Password_Reset: To reset your Intranet password, use the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page, or visit the IT Helpdesk with your student ID.
IT_Support_Portal_Access: Portal access problems can often be resolved by clearing your browser cache or resetting your password; contact IT Support at Administration Block A, 2nd floor if the issue persists.
IT_Support_WiFi_Issue: If campus wifi isn't working, try reconnecting to the campus wifi network with your student credentials, or report the issue to the IT Helpdesk.
Language_Of_Instruction: Yes, all classes are conducted fully in English, except MPU courses such as Penghayatan Am dan Etika. For tutorial/practical classes, if all students and the tutor are comfortable with Chinese or Malay, the class may sometimes mix in multiple languages for better understanding.
Library_Borrowing_Books: Students can borrow books using their student ID at the library counter; borrowing limits and duration vary by membership type.
Library_Discussion_Room_Booking: Discussion rooms at Penang campus can be booked via the TARC App or Intranet, but require at least 4 students. The maximum booking is 2 hours, with an additional hour available at the counter.
Library_Discussion_Room_Key: All 4 students in the booking must show up with their student IDs to collect the discussion room key at the counter, whether it's a walk-in reservation or a key pickup after booking on the app.
Library_Late_Fine: Late fines vary depending on how the book is categorized. Please check with the librarian for the exact fine amount for your specific book.
Library_Opening_Hours: The TARUMT Penang Library is open from 8:30am to 5:30pm.
Library_Renewing_Books: Books can be renewed online via the library portal or in person, provided there are no holds from other students on the title.
Orientation_Duration: For long semester intakes (June/July), orientation usually runs 5 days from 8:00am to 5:00pm. For short semester intakes (January/November), it's usually just 1 day.
Orientation_Events: Orientation aims to introduce students to the university and their faculty, with talks about the faculty and sometimes broader topics (e.g. global warming). The programme is designed by the Student Representative Council (SRC), so events vary each year, but usually include icebreaking games and a counselling session. Refer to the Orientation timetable for the exact schedule.
Orientation_Necessity: While not compulsory, attending orientation is recommended - it provides Graduate Attribute (GA) points, includes distribution of the orientation kit, and covers useful info like how to apply for PTPTN financial aid.
Orientation_What_To_Bring: Bring your tumbler, your offer letter (on the first day), and a small backpack to keep your belongings. A mini fan and power bank are also encouraged.
Out_Of_Scope: I'm the TARUMT FAQ assistant, so I'm only able to help with questions about TARUMT courses, admissions, facilities, and student services. For anything else, you may want to check a general search engine or another resource.
Parking_Sticker_Registration: Parking stickers are available during the first week of each new semester. Students register via the Intranet when registration opens, and will be notified through a notification on the Intranet/TARC App.
Ptptn_Application_Process: To apply for a PTPTN loan, submit your application through the PTPTN online portal before the stipulated deadline, along with your academic results and supporting documents. The Student Financial Aid Office can help if you need guidance with the application.
Ptptn_Disbursement: PTPTN loans are disbursed each semester upon confirmation. The funds are first paid directly to the university to cover your tuition fees, and any remaining balance is transferred to you as a living allowance. Disbursement dates vary by semester and will be announced by PTPTN once your application is approved. You can check your exact disbursement date via the PTPTN portal or by consulting the Student Financial Aid Office.
Ptptn_Eligibility: PTPTN eligibility generally requires Malaysian citizenship, enrollment in an approved programme, and meeting household income criteria.
Ptptn_Repayment: PTPTN repayment typically begins about a year after graduation or course completion; repayment amount and schedule can be checked via the PTPTN portal.
Scholarship_Application_Process: The Merit Scholarship is awarded automatically upon admission if you meet the criteria - no separate application needed. For other scholarships, watch for notifications via the Intranet/TARC App and apply as instructed when they open.
Scholarship_Merit_Criteria: The TAR UMT Merit Scholarship offers up to 100% tuition fee waiver for outstanding Malaysian students, awarded automatically upon admission. For Bachelor's programmes, 3 A's at STPM/A Level (or 8 A's at UEC) gives 100% waiver, with lower grade tiers giving 50%/25%/20%. For Diploma/Foundation, a minimum of 8A+/A at SPM gives 100%, with lower tiers giving 50%/25%/20%/15%. Scholars must maintain a CGPA of 3.5 and above with straight passes (including co-curriculum) to keep the full waiver.
Scholarship_Other_Types: Besides the automatic Merit Scholarship, other scholarships may open for registration from time to time - students are notified via the Intranet or TARC App when applications open.
Scholarship_Renewal: To retain your Merit Scholarship, you must maintain the CGPA threshold tied to your award tier (e.g. CGPA 3.5 and above to keep a 100% waiver) with straight passes including co-curriculum each semester; falling below the threshold reduces or withdraws the scholarship.
Student_ID_Collection: Student ID cards are collected at the Student Affairs counter; collection timing is announced during orientation or via the Intranet.
Student_ID_First_Application: New students receive their student ID card during registration/orientation week after enrollment is confirmed.
Student_ID_Replacement: A replacement fee applies for a lost student ID card; check the current amount with Student Affairs when reporting the loss.
Student_ID_Usage: Your student ID must be worn at all times while on campus. Students without their ID card are required to register at the Main Entrance Guard House and have their status verified before being allowed in.
Tuition_Fee_Amount_By_Program: Tuition fees vary significantly by programme and level - Foundation programmes are around RM9,900-10,200, while Diploma and Degree programmes range roughly from RM18,900 to RM44,705+ depending on the field of study. Check the official fee schedule for your specific programme.
Tuition_Fee_Late_Penalty: Late tuition fee payment may incur a penalty charge and could delay your course registration; contact the Finance Office if facing payment difficulties.
Tuition_Fee_Payment_Deadline: Tuition fee payment deadlines are set before each semester's registration period; check the Academic Calendar for exact dates.
Tuition_Fee_Payment_Methods: Tuition fees can be paid via online banking, credit/debit card, or in person at the Finance counter.
Academic_Calendar_IntakeStart: May intake schedules span 14 instructional weeks. Orientation events and registration checks occur during the 3 days prior to class commencement.
Academic_Calendar_NextIntake: Future intake calendar structures are updated dynamically on the TARUMT registration page. Ensure you select the correct year and level of study before saving.
Contact_AdmissionsOffice: The Admissions Office can be reached via the contact details on the TARUMT website's Admissions/Contact Us page.
Enrollment_New_Intake: For the May intake, ensure you accept your offer online and pay the first-semester fees before the deadline stated in your offer letter.
Hostel_Application: TARUMT Penang branch does not have an on-campus hostel available for application. Students may visit the Department of Student Affairs, or attend an open day, to obtain the contact list of housing agents in the area.
Merit_Scholarships_Available: Merit scholarships are awarded based on academic performance and are open to eligible students each intake. Details on available merit scholarships can be found on the Scholarship Office's website or by visiting them directly.
PTPTN_Loan_Status: You can check your PTPTN loan status by logging into the PTPTN online portal with your IC number and password. If the status isn't updating, contact the Student Financial Aid Office for assistance.
PTPTN_Portal_Access: The PTPTN portal can be accessed via the official PTPTN website using your IC number and registered password. If you're having trouble logging in, the Student Financial Aid Office can help you regain access.
PTPTN_Required_Documents: Documents typically needed for a PTPTN application include your IC, parents'/guardian's income statements, academic results, and proof of an SSPN-i account. The Student Financial Aid Office can confirm the full checklist for your case.
SSPN_Account_Requirement: PTPTN generally requires an active SSPN-i account as part of the loan application. You can open one at any Bank Simpanan Nasional branch or online, and the Student Financial Aid Office can confirm the current requirement.
